title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: As the regularization parameter lambda (λ) increases, the penalty on large coefficients increases, which tends to reduce the model's variance.

title: Variance and Bias Trade-off
text: Increasing lambda (λ) reduces variance but may increase bias. However, the statement focuses on variance, which tends to zero as lambda increases.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the effect of lambda on variance, is the statement 'As λ increases, model variance tends to 0' true or false?
